label: thm:markov-trace-product
title: Product factorization of the Markov trace
html:
Theorem. Product factorization of the Markov trace

Let \beta \in B_n be a braid and let \rho(\beta) \in H_n(R, q) be its Hecke reduction. The element \rho(\beta) decomposes as a product of generator chains: a_i \sigma_i + b_i with a_i, b_i \in \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}].

Theorem. The Markov trace factors as a product over generators:

  \mathrm{tr}_M\!\bigl(\rho(\beta)\bigr) = \prod_{i=0}^{n-2} \hat{V}_i(q), \qquad \hat{V}_i(q) = z \cdot a_i + b_i,

where z = q^{3}/(q^{2}+1) is the Markov parameter (convention D). Each \hat{V}_i is the vertex volume at generator \sigma_i, representing the evaluation of the vertex operator at the i-th insertion point on the exceptional divisor.
